FAILURE (P1): inline Add-Category flow does NOT auto-select the newly-created category — trigger stays on 'Select trade' placeholder after category creation succeeds server-side. RCA: EmployeeCategoryFormModal calls onCreated(data) synchronously right after qc.invalidateQueries — the categories query refetch is async, so when EmployeeFormModal's setForm sets category_id=String(newCat.id), the Radix <Select> has no matching <SelectItem> for that value yet, so Radix shows the placeholder. When the query refetches, the SelectItem appears but the Select's internal selected state was already latched as invalid. Fix: in EmployeeCategoryFormModal.submit, use `await qc.refetchQueries({queryKey:['employeeCategories']})` BEFORE onCreated(data), OR do an optimistic setQueryData that appends the new category immediately so the SelectItem exists when the parent setForm runs.

rca of the issue: Root cause: In /app/frontend/src/features/projectPlanning/components/EmployeeCategoryFormModal.jsx line 30-31, after POST 201 the code calls `qc.invalidateQueries({queryKey:['employeeCategories']})` (which is fire-and-forget, only marks stale) then IMMEDIATELY `onCreated?.(data)` which in turn calls `setForm({...f, category_id: String(cat.id)})` in the parent EmployeeFormModal. The Radix Select's <SelectContent> children come from the `categories` state which has NOT refetched yet, so no <SelectItem value={newCat.id}> exists. Radix Select receives value=newId but sees no matching child → falls back to placeholder 'Select trade'. Even after refetch adds the item ~50–200ms later, Radix's internal selectedValue state remains desynced from the controlled `value` prop. Reproduction: raj login → /portal/site-engineer → pick any project → Add Employee → Category dropdown → + Add Category → name='X' → submit → observe category trigger still shows 'Select trade'. Mitigation: use qc.setQueryData to optimistically append the new category to the cache before calling onCreated, guaranteeing the SelectItem exists when the parent setForm runs.
